import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 10000000;
    static final int N = 210;
    static final int M = 21000;

    static class Edge {
        int v, w;
        public Edge(int v, int w) {
            this.v = v;
            this.w = w;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[N];
    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[M];
    static int[] head = new int[N], e;
    static int S, T;
    static int[] dist = new int[N], q = new int[N * 2], arc = new int[N], gap = new int[N], inq = new int[N], pre = new int[N];

    static char[][] grid1 = new char[12][12], grid2 = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] sci = new int[12][12], ca = new int[12][12], stone = new int[62][12][12];
    static int[][][][][] dp = new int[62][12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] dir = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int n, t;

    static int[] visited = new int[12*12];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid1[i] = (' ' + line).toCharArray(); // 1-based indexing
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') stone[0][i][j] = 2;
                else if (grid1[i][j] == 'Y') stone[0][i][j] = 1;
                else sci[i][j] = grid1[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid2[i] = (' ' + line).toCharArray();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid2[i][j] >= '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') ca[i][j] = grid2[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }

        expand();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
                    dfs(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int k = 1; k <= t; k++) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                    for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; nx++) {
                        for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ny++) {
                            dp[k][x][y][nx][ny] += dp[k - 1][x][y][nx][ny];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        S = 0;
        T = n * n * 2 + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
            adj[i].clear();
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                add_edge(S, (i - 1) * n + j, sci[i][j]);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                add_edge(n * n + (i - 1) * n + j, T, ca[i][j]);
            }
        }
        for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; nx++) {
                    for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ny++) {
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && ca[nx][ny] != 0) {
                            if (dp[t][x][y][nx][ny] != 0) {
                                add_edge((x - 1) * n + y, n * n + (nx - 1) * n + ny, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = max_flow(S, T);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void expand() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= t; k++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    if (stone[k - 1][i][j] == 1)
                        stone[k][i][j] = 1;
                    else if (stone[k - 1][i][j] == 2)
                        stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                    else {
                        for (int z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
                            int nx = i + dir[z][0], ny = j + dir[z][1];
                            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n) {
                                if (stone[k - 1][nx][ny] == 2)
                                    stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void dfs(int x, int y, int nowx, int nowy, int k) {
        int index = (nowx - 1) * n + nowy;
        visited[index] = 1;
        dp[k][x][y][nowx][nowy] = 1;
        if (k >= t || stone[k][nowx][nowy] != 0) return;
        for (int z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
            int nx = nowx + dir[z][0], ny = nowy + dir[z][1];
            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && visited[(nx - 1) * n + ny] == 0) {
                if (stone[k][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                dfs(x, y, nx, ny, k + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int w) {
        edges[e[0]] = new Edge(v, w);
        adj[u].add(e[0]);
        e[0]++;
        edges[e[0]] = new Edge(u, 0);
        adj[v].add(e[0]);
        e[0]++;
    }

    static int max_flow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(arc, -1);
        Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
        int front = 0, rear = 0;
        q[rear++] = t; inq[t] = 1; gap[0]++;
        dist[t] = 0;
        while (front < rear) {
            int u = q[front++];
            for (int i : adj[u]) {
                int v = edges[i].v;
                if (inq[v] == 0) {
                    q[rear++] = v;
                    inq[v] = 1;
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    gap[dist[v]]++;
                    arc[v] = i;
                }
            }
        }
        int flow = 0, u = s, low = INF;
        Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
        pre[s] = s;
        while (dist[s] < t) {
            boolean pushed = false;
            for (int i = arc[u]; i != -1; i = (i >= 0 && i < edges.length) ? (adj[u].contains(i) ? i : -1) : -1) {
                if (i == -1) break;
                if (edges[i].w > 0 && dist[edges[i].v] + 1 == dist[u]) {
                    pushed = true;
                    low = Math.min(low, edges[i].w);
                    pre[edges[i].v] = u;
                    u = edges[i].v;
                    if (u == t) {
                        int delta = low;
                        while (u != s) {
                            int iEdge = pre[u];
                            for (int idx : adj[iEdge]) {
                                if (edges[idx].v == u) {
                                    edges[idx].w -= delta;
                                    edges[idx ^ 1].w += delta;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            u = pre[u];
                        }
                        flow += delta;
                        low = INF;
                        u = s;
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (pushed) continue;
            int minDist = t + 1;
            for (int i : adj[u]) {
                int v = edges[i].v;
                if (edges[i].w > 0 && dist[v] < minDist) {
                    minDist = dist[v];
                    arc[u] = i;
                }
            }
            gap[dist[u]]--;
            if (gap[dist[u]] == 0) break;
            dist[u] = minDist + 1;
            gap[dist[u]]++;
            u = pre[u];
        }
        return flow;
    }
}
